import json
from collections import defaultdict

PROJECT = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier"
TEST_DATA = f"{PROJECT}/data/swebench_full/test.jsonl"
PRED_FILE = f"{PROJECT}/results/repo_cls_v5_ckpt4600_test/eval_repo_cls_predictions.jsonl"

# Load test data
test_rows = []
with open(TEST_DATA) as f:
    for line in f:
        d = json.loads(line)
        test_rows.append((d["problem_id"], d["mutation_type"], d["label"]))

# Load predictions
preds = []
with open(PRED_FILE) as f:
    for line in f:
        preds.append(json.loads(line))

print(f"Test rows: {len(test_rows)}, Predictions: {len(preds)}")
assert len(test_rows) == len(preds), "Mismatch!"

# Derive variant ground truth from test data (AND rule on labels)
variant_gt = defaultdict(list)
for pid, mut, label in test_rows:
    variant_gt[(pid, mut)].append(label)

gt_labels = {}
for key, labels in variant_gt.items():
    gt_labels[key] = 1 if all(l == 1 for l in labels) else 0

print(f"Variants: {len(gt_labels)}")
print(f"Resolved: {sum(gt_labels.values())}, Unresolved: {len(gt_labels) - sum(gt_labels.values())}")

# Aggregate predictions to variant level
variant_preds = defaultdict(list)
for i, pred in enumerate(preds):
    pid, mut, _ = test_rows[i]
    pred_val = pred.get("pred", pred.get("prediction"))
    variant_preds[(pid, mut)].append(pred_val)

# Compute variant-level results
print(f"\n{'variant_id':<60s} {'tests':>5s} {'pass':>5s} {'fail':>5s} {'gt':>3s} {'pred':>4s} {'ok':>3s}")
print("-" * 85)
correct = 0
total = 0
for key in sorted(gt_labels.keys()):
    pid, mut = key
    vkey = f"{pid}__{mut}"
    pred_list = variant_preds[key]
    pred_resolved = 1 if all(p == 1 for p in pred_list) else 0
    gt = gt_labels[key]
    n_pass = sum(1 for p in pred_list if p == 1)
    n_fail = sum(1 for p in pred_list if p == 0)
    ok = "Y" if pred_resolved == gt else "N"
    if ok == "Y":
        correct += 1
    total += 1
    print(f"{vkey:<60s} {len(pred_list):>5d} {n_pass:>5d} {n_fail:>5d} {gt:>3d} {pred_resolved:>4d} {ok:>3s}")

print(f"\nAccuracy: {correct}/{total} = {correct/total*100:.2f}%")
